summary: Customer reports streamed responses end early / truncated output in SDK (no explicit SSE error)
description:
Issue summary:
Northwind reports some streaming responses appear to stop mid-sentence in their app. They do not always see a clear SSE/network error in logs; they just get a shorter-than-expected message and the stream iterator ends.

Support notes:
- Using redwood-sdk-python (OpenAI-compatible)
- stream=true on chat completions
- Reported pattern: more common on long tool-augmented prompts; retries usually produce full result

Investigation:
Support replayed request IDs and saw the server stream ends without [DONE] delivered to the client when the downstream connection was closed. In some client libraries this surfaces as a clean EOF rather than an exception.

Resolution:
Marked duplicate of SUP-5321 / incident INC-2025-11-12-STREAM. Customer advised to upgrade SDK (includes improved logging) and apply workaround until keep-alive rollout reached eu-west.
comments: Aisha Rahman (Support): Escalating because customer says the assistant output is sometimes just cut off. They do not mention 'SSE' but symptoms match streaming termination.
Ava Chen (Platform): Checked gateway logs for provided request IDs; saw downstream close due to idle timeout. Client library likely treats it as EOF.
Aisha Rahman: Shared workaround: temporarily disable streaming for the longest responses or set client-side read timeout > 60s; also suggested splitting prompts.
Ava Chen: Confirmed fix in SUP-5321 will address; rollout to eu-west scheduled 11/17.
Closing as duplicate of SUP-5321 once customer confirms post-rollout.
